result.summary: Resets `bump_fee_group_discount` to zero inside `SelectionResult::Clear()`. It also adds a unit test confirming that an emptied selection reports zero bump fees instead of a negative value.
result.problem: When `SelectionResult::Clear()` is called, it removes selected inputs and resets waste and weight, but leaves the ancestor bump fee discount intact. Calling `GetTotalBumpFees()` on the cleared selection subtracts this leftover discount from zero, producing a negative bump fee total. While existing production code only clears selections in the knapsack solver prior to calculating the discount, this leaves a latent bug for any future reuse of `SelectionResult`.
evidence: PR description: "`SelectionResult::Clear()` removes the selected inputs but keeps their bump fee discount. `GetTotalBumpFees()` then subtracts that discount from zero, so any positive discount gives the empty selection a negative fee total. The wallet currently avoids this because it only clears selections inside the knapsack solver, before applying the discount."
result.changed_since_previous: No functional changes; the complete patch and commit history have been provided.
result.card: Resets the ancestor bump fee discount to zero when clearing a SelectionResult in wallet coin selection, and adds a regression test. SelectionResult::Clear() previously emptied selected inputs but preserved their bump fee discount, causing subsequent calls to GetTotalBumpFees() on the empty selection to calculate a negative total. The wallet currently avoids user-visible bugs because knapsack coin selection only invokes Clear() before computing the discount.

risk.why: A mistake in resetting coin selection state could lead to inaccurate fee or waste calculations during coin selection.
